instagram.caption:
Painting business owners: make AI quote from your own price list, and flag what you never priced.

The prompt (put it on top of your price list in a phone note):
Turn my walkthrough notes into quote lines. Use only my price list. Flag anything that is not on it. Never guess a price.

The real reply (Gemini 3.8 Flash through Google's API, Nov 1, 2026 (the free app may run another model, so yours will read differently)):
Walls (Living Room): 1 room, [my price]
Ceiling (Living Room): 1 room, [my price]
Doors: 2, 2x [my price]
Drywall patch: 1 patch, [my price]
FLAGGED ITEM (Not on price list):
Stair railing (painting): This item is not on your price list. A custom price is needed.

One run: four lines, one flag, no price guessed. Not a promise it always flags. The railing is yours to price. Check every line before it goes out.

1. Type your price list in a phone note. Once.
2. Put this prompt at the top.
3. After each walkthrough, add your notes and paste it all into Gemini.
4. Price the flags. Check every line. Then send.

Send this to your painter who still quotes from memory.
Free tools for trade owners: link in bio.
